Bug_Title: VA: Primitive array passed to function expecting a variable number of object arguments (VA_PRIMITIVE_ARRAY_PASSED_TO_OBJECT_VARARG)
Bug_Details:
This code passes a primitive array to a function that takes a variable number of object arguments.
This creates an array of length one to hold the primitive array and passes it to the function.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the `showBug` method where a primitive array is passed to `varargMethod` which expects a variable number of object arguments.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered when the testShowBug method is called, as it invokes the showBug method of the PrimitiveArrayToObjectVarargBug class. This method, in turn, passes a primitive array to the varargMethod, which expects a variable number of object arguments, causing a ClassCastException.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results confirm the presence of the bug. When the showBug() method is called in the test, it prints '[I@29444d75', which is the default string representation of an array. This indicates that the primitive array is being treated as a single object argument, which is the expected behavior when a primitive array is passed to a vararg method expecting objects.
